movement.title: Match replay
movement.subtitle: Seven professional matches, replayed from tracking data to show what the engine can read: where every player was, the shape of each team and who is nearest to each part of the pitch.

about.title: What you are looking at
about.match: Seven professional men's matches (Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga, 2022/23) from the DFL open dataset. They are here to show what the engine can read from tracking data, nothing more.
about.grassroots: Your own matches have no tracking data: that needs cameras or sensors a grassroots club does not have. Klupa never invents it.
about.space: "Space control" here simply means which player is nearest to each part of the pitch. It is not a physical model: it ignores speed, direction and who would really get there first.
about.sampling: Positions are stored 4 times a second and smoothed in between, so motion is drawn, not filmed. The ball's height is not in the data, so it is drawn on the grass.
about.anonymous: In the replay, players are only a club and a shirt number. The physical report uses the short names from the public match information.
about.citation: Bassek, M., Rein, R., Weber, H. and Memmert, D. (2025). An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer. figshare, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.28196177.v1. Paper: Scientific Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y.
about.licence: Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changed by Klupa: positions resampled to 4 a second, rounded to centimetres and reduced to side and shirt number; physical measures computed from the full 25 a second.

physical.title: Physical report
physical.intro: How much each player ran in this match, measured by Klupa from the full 25 positions a second. It describes running, not how well anyone played.
physical.errorTitle: The physical report could not be loaded
physical.errorBody: The replay above does not need it. Try again.
physical.tableCaption: {{club}}: every player who played, longest distance first

def.speed: Speed: how far a player moved over 0.4 seconds, from {{hz}} positions a second.
def.minutes: Minutes: clock minutes on the pitch, from the kick-off of each half to the last tracked moment, dead-ball time included.
def.distance: Distance: everything a player covered while on the pitch.
def.highSpeed: High-speed distance: distance covered faster than {{mps}} m/s ({{kmh}} km/h).
def.sprints: Sprints: runs of at least {{seconds}} s at {{mps}} m/s ({{kmh}} km/h) or faster.
def.topSpeed: Top speed: the fastest 0.4-second speed, shown in km/h (1 m/s is 3.6 km/h). It is not the instant value a broadcaster shows.

physical.quality: {{seconds}} seconds of player time ({{share}}% of it) are left out of distance, sprints and top speed: there the tracking lost a player and snapped back faster than {{jump}} m/s, which no footballer can run. Those seconds still count as minutes.
physical.names: Names are the short names from the public match information.
